entry.title: Central Plaza
entry.note: Fresh OSM API on 2026-10-10 confirms exact Q112640 whole 27087018 and eight separately retained crown/roof/mast geometries, unchanged from independent map-parts. Signed heading 0.076907698117 puts +X east-northeast and +Z south-southeast; the broad +Z face fronts Gloucester Road. Owner 2025 guide independently describes south, northwest and northeast facades; Arup 1993 north-arrow site/first-floor plans corroborate the clipped triangular compass phase. Native mast center [-0.01329,4.79924] is independently checked against part 1047690918. Source Y=0 is published 4.1 mPD street datum, not sea level; 378.4 mPD tip gives 374.3 m above street. Map height 309 m is an envelope-era figure, not mast height. Accept 2 m footprint / 1 degree reconstruction allowance; automatic replacement disabled. Separate adjoining 30.5 m podium, garden, bridges and neighbouring towers are outside tower scope. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
